verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Runbooks are explicitly described as a condition-based automation engine that triggers on incident events, evaluating conditions to decide whether to fire, and can perform tasks like role assignment, task list creation, Slack/Jira actions, webhooks to internal systems, and status/field updates, directly matching the SRE automation-runbooks story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of runbook reliability at scale and deeper detail on reminder-type conditional triggers beyond incident declaration/resolution.
